name: Farida Bano
title: Textile Pattern Artist
bio: Farida specialises in geometric textile composition for our cloth earring line. She works from a sunlit room where cotton is cut, backed, and paired — a rhythm she has kept for twenty-five years.
quote: Cloth carries intention. I finish each pair as if the wearer is in the room.

name: Priya Sharma
title: Block Print Textile Artist
bio: Priya carves wooden blocks and prints natural dyes onto cotton and linen for our cloth earrings. Each motif is pressed by hand — no two prints are identical, and she considers that the soul of the piece.
quote: A print is a fingerprint. The block remembers every press.

name: Meenakshi Iyer
title: Silk Thread Finisher
bio: Meenakshi winds silk thread for earring drops, tassels, and braided closures. She learned from her grandmother how to match thread tension so each coil holds its shape through seasons of wear.
quote: Thread must hold memory — of the hand that wound it and the ear that wears it.

name: Ravi Desai
title: Upcycled Cloth Specialist
bio: Ravi turns sari borders, mill offcuts, and leftover linen into backings and patterned faces for cloth earrings. His workshop is a library of rescued textiles — each scrap tagged with origin and story.
quote: Nothing is waste until we decide to throw it away. Fabric deserves second lives.

name: Kavita Patel
title: Textile Composition Artist
bio: Kavita layers patterned cloth so light and colour sit honestly in each earring — geometric bands, mustard fields, cocoa crescents. Every pair is composed by hand so the two sides speak to each other.
quote: Cloth should catch light the way a well-cut blouse does — quietly, and on the move.
